verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a built-in Apollo Sandbox at api.fireflies.ai/graphql for interactive schema introspection and query execution with a bearer key. It also offers an examples section with code snippets and Replit projects you can run against the API. However, the evidence does not show the reference pages themselves embedding runnable 'try it' examples, so the interactive explorer and the runnable examples live in separate places. missing for 10: evidence that the API reference pages are themselves interactive with inline runnable examples, documented linkage between reference entries and runnable samples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox and Replit examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: For introspection using our builtin Apollo Sandbox, visit api.fireflies.ai/graphql and enter your api_key in the Headers section as a Bearer token
Explore a wide array of examples where we have created code snippets that allows you to interact with the Fireflies API.
This replit allows you to query questions asked by participants who do not belong to your organization.
